correctness.rationale: On the actual algebra, derivations preserve its full derived ideal. The commutator relation [B,A]=aA implies a=0 by f(A)=0 and invertibility of A f'(A); hence the centralizer is exactly the field algebra. Symmetry yields a 3d-dimensional biderivation family, and the remaining CPA identity is equivalent to c=0 and b(b-alpha)=0. Finite-etale splitting proves exactly 2^d geometric affine components, Frobenius-fixed idempotent counts 2^gcd(d,s), their necklace zeta, and the rank formula by splitting free w against im(b). Field-square brute-force verification over F2 and F3 degrees two and three, and F4 scalar extension, completed successfully; all-field claims rest on proof.

value.rationale: The question measures exactly which symmetric Lie biderivations integrate to commutative post-Lie products on a natural infinite family of irreducible almost-abelian Lie algebras. The answer identifies an entire finite-etale disconnected CPA scheme, an explicit all-extension Hasse–Weil zeta function, newly appearing scalar-extension ranks and characteristic-dependent orbit counts. These geometric/arithmetic invariants are structurally motivated and not just recomputation of a routine finite table.
